rationale: Keep ALLETE, Inc. as the surviving private utility platform after the December 15, 2025 take-private. CPP Investments owns 40% indirectly and GIP-managed vehicles own 60% indirectly. BlackRock is GIP's parent and is not a separate owner. The 2026 regulatory filings describe a pending internal reorganization, not a completed ownership change or exit.

GIP Fund V and the GIP-managed Tower Bridge vehicle together hold 60% indirectly

The filing does not establish an economic owner exit or transfer

companyFieldUpdates.description: ALLETE, Inc. is a Duluth, Minnesota-based utility holding company whose businesses include Minnesota Power, Superior Water, Light and Power, ALLETE Clean Energy, BNI Energy, New Energy Equity and other energy infrastructure interests. Its regulated utility footprint is concentrated in Minnesota and Wisconsin, with clean-energy activities across North America. The take-private announced in May 2024 closed on December 15, 2025, and ALLETE survived as a privately held company under Alloy Parent LLC. CPP Investments owns 40% indirectly and Global Infrastructure Partners-managed vehicles own the remaining 60% indirectly, comprising GIP Fund V and the GIP-managed Tower Bridge vehicle. BlackRock is shown only as GIP's parent, not as a separate owner. Regulatory filings in 2026 describe a pending internal reorganization around Minnesota Power, not a completed ownership transfer. No later owner exit or signed platform sale was identified through August 23, 2026.

set.event: ALLETE announced an agreement to be acquired by a partnership led by CPP Investments and Global Infrastructure Partners for approximately US$6.2 billion including debt.

The CPP Investments and Global Infrastructure Partners take-private closed; ALLETE survived as a private company under Alloy Parent with 40% indirect CPP ownership and 60% indirect ownership by GIP-managed vehicles.
A federal filing described a proposed internal ALLETE reorganization involving Minnesota Power; it did not change the economic owner set and remained pending.
